note: September closed at 12,643 bookings against a 16,408 target and 13,421 in August. Read the target as reference: the shape that matters is down 8.3 percent year on year. Aqua Shard is more than the whole of that gap on its own, 4,994 against 7,654 last September, a fall of 2,660 set against a portfolio shortfall of 1,139. DSL pulls the other way at nearly four times last September, on a target set before the rebrand and therefore not comparable. Hutong at 3,773 against 3,598 and Azzurra at 409 against 389 are both ahead of last year. Regent St at 1,062 against 1,128 and Shiro Sushi at 396 against 469 are behind, and in both cases it is traffic rather than conversion. Covers tell a better story than bookings across the market, so read this next to the weekly covers reports.
